title: Exceptional Private Tour of Barcelona with Rodingo
text:
We spent an incredible day in Barcelona with Rodingo as our private guide. He took us to breathtaking spots like Sagrada Família, Park Güell, Gaudí’s apartments, and beautiful city overlooks, sharing fascinating insights about the city’s history and culture along the way.
Rodingo was especially thoughtful in accommodating my husband’s balance issues — arranging wheelchairs where needed and organizing everything to ensure comfort and accessibility. He personally hailed all our taxis and made sure every part of the day ran smoothly.
